purpose: Separate SAFOR Framework/schema design, isolated validation and real HUMAN project execution so governance and agent activation requirements cannot be conflated.

DESIGN.purpose: Author or revise SAFOR Framework, schemas, policies and package definitions.
rules: A DESIGN target may be the canonical SAFOR product repository or another explicitly approved Framework/package development workspace.
DESIGN must not mutate a HUMAN project Value Creation Stream as if executing that project.
Agent use is optional and still requires a bound Agent Runtime Adapter.

VALIDATION.purpose: Validate SAFOR behavior, schemas, replay, packages or runtime integration in an explicitly isolated test harness.
rules: Validation targets must be explicitly identified as isolated/non-production.
HUMAN_MANUAL_TEST_ONLY activation is permitted only here and only when the validation objective requires a manual host test harness.
Validation evidence may prove SAFOR conformance but cannot silently satisfy production execution mandates, production Work Item acceptance or business outcome authority.

EXECUTION.purpose: Execute a real HUMAN project Value Creation Stream under Factory, Operating Model and project authority.
rules: All project mutations remain inside the HUMAN-selected project workspace.
Routine agent activation, continuation and result transport are system/runtime responsibilities.
Missing agent automation blocks AGENT dispatch with AGENT_RUNTIME_AUTOMATION_UNAVAILABLE; it must not become a HUMAN copy/paste or chat-wakeup task.
